title: Kamishiro Rui — Stoic Villain?〔Part1〕Side Story (Part 1)

rows.Line: Night
Rui's Room

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line:
Phew...
That took much longer than I was expecting.

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: But I'm glad that I was able to finish it in time for practice. So, tomorrow...

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: I'll show my creations off to Tsukasa and the others, as well as everyone from Mikazukigumi.
The next day
Mikazukigumi Practice Area

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: So, Rui, what is it that you wanted to show us?

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Ah, they're something I've been working on in between discussions with the prop team.

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: I'm happy to announce that the jitte Ginnosuke and Heihachi will be using are done.

rows.Speaker: Prop Team Member
rows.Line:
Oh, you finished making them?!
Can we see?

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line:
Of course.
Here's what I made.

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: They should still look rather intimidating, but I tried using a material that's both light and soft.

rows.Speaker: Kijima
rows.Line: Interesting...

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Their lightness should make them easier to wield so they don't get in the way of any involved stunts.

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: The softness of this material should also prevent any accidents from occurring. For example, in the event that one were to fly into the crowd.

rows.Speaker: Prop Team Member
rows.Line: Look at that. It looks like it's made of metal, but it's unbelievably soft...!

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Yes, I worked very hard to get the paint job right.

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: We'll be performing in the middle of the street, so our audience will be watching from up close.

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: I did my best to both make them look real and ensure the safety of the guests.

rows.Speaker: Prop Team Member
rows.Line: I see...

rows.Speaker: Kijima
rows.Line: Wow, these are going to be huge for us...

rows.Speaker: Kijima
rows.Line: This show involves a lot of stunts and action, which has made audience safety a worry.

rows.Speaker: Kijima
rows.Line: We can't afford to wait until it's too late. In that sense, these jitte are lifesavers!

rows.Speaker: Kijima
rows.Line: I'm impressed, Kamishiro!

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line:
Ah, thank you very much.
Now all the effort I put in suddenly feels worth it.

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line:
Heh. You see?!
That's Rui Kamishiro for you!

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: You see?!

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Why are you two acting so proud...?

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line:
Still, these jitte are astonishing...
Excellent work, Rui!

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: What you brought today was a real surprise since you're always making these strange and weird props.

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: We will be using them for Mikazukigumi's show, so I was more than happy to match the prop team's needs.

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: That being said...

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: I actually made a few others in my spare time.

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Wait, really?

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Yes, they're still prototypes, but they're coming along rather nicely. Starting with...

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line:
These.
They're rainbow jitte that glow a hundred colors!

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Why'd you make them light up?

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Hehe. I thought they'd come in handy during any night showing.

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: They even leave streaks in the air when you wave them around like this. They'd make for a fun new effect, no?

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Wow, they really are fun and flashy!

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Also, I made some jitte that can transform. When all five combine, they'll turn into a robot. Would you like to give it a try?

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: No, that won't be necessary!

rows.Speaker: Kijima
rows.Line: Wait, actually...

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: What?! Mr. Kijima?!

rows.Speaker: Kijima
rows.Line: A historical drama that involves a transforming robot... I've never heard of anything like that! The kids would love it!

rows.Speaker: Kijima
rows.Line: I mean, what boy doesn't adore these kinds of robots?!

rows.Speaker: Mikazukigumi Member
rows.Line:
Yeah... It might not be such a crazy idea!
Can we take a closer look at those, Kamishiro?

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Oh, I wanna play with them too!

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Wh-What...?!

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line:
There should be a button on the grip.
Press it to...

rows.Speaker: Kijima
rows.Line: Wh-Whoa! This is...!!!

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: I thought he made something normal for a change...

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: But Rui will be Rui...
